function.name: web_request
function.description: Fetches and/or summarizes data from a URL. If 'summarize' is true, a summarization is returned. Otherwise, if the data is text/html, text is extracted. If the data size exceeds a configured max it is truncated, which may result in malformed json for large application/json data.

summarize.description: true = summarize content at URL. Not present implies false.

compact.description: Only when 'summarize' is true. false = human consumption, true = model consumption. Not present implies false.
